[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended using a water-based leather conditioner for the Birkenstocks, such as Birkenstock Leather Care Conditioner, Nikwax Tech Wash Leather Conditioner, Bickmore Leather Conditioner, or Chamber's Leather Conditioner.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested conditioning the Birkenstocks every 2-3 weeks or more frequently if worn daily.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised cleaning the Birkenstocks with a soft-bristled brush or a clean, damp cloth before conditioning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended applying a leather protector or waterproofing spray to the Birkenstocks for extra protection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided steps for cleaning suede shoes, including using a suede brush, suede-specific cleaner, and a gentle damp cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed popular suede cleaners: Saphir Suede Cleaner, Nikwax Tech Wash Suede Cleaner, Scotchgard Suede & Nubuck Cleaner, and Kiwi Suede Cleaner.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided detailed steps for cleaning suede loafers, including inspecting, applying cleaner, blotting, allowing to dry, and brushing again.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised against using regular leather cleaners or harsh chemicals on suede.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using a mild soap and water solution for cleaning the straps of the Birkenstocks, and recommended Birkenstock-specific cleaners.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Encouraged user to be honest about the condition of the Ugg boots when selling them online.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested cleaning the Ugg boots before listing them for sale and taking clear photos.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended platforms for selling the Ugg boots, including eBay, Poshmark, ThredUp, and Facebook Marketplace.
